links.comparator_used: Nonaugmented generation (NAG, no retrieval) and static-augmented generation (SAG, fixed content in the prompt)
links.outcome: ADE identification F1-score and recall at the L3 (overlap) matching level across DeepSeek-V3, ERNIE 3.5-8K and GPT-4o
links.effect: RAG yielded higher F1-scores than NAG and SAG at L3 across the tested LLMs; best configuration DeepSeek-V3 with RAG had L3 F1 0.9638 (95% CI 0.9541-0.9727); GPT-4o recall rose from 0.6419 (NAG) to 0.9241 (RAG), FDR P=.003
links.quote: Across the tested LLMs, RAG yielded higher F1-scores than NAG and SAG at the L3 level.

design_hint: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to existing LLMs
